verdict.rationale: Codex's CLI docs say developers can "package repeatable instructions as skills" and add plugins that connect Codex to team tools and data. MCP servers can extend its toolset, and subagents can take on specialized work. Skills themselves appear only in a one-line summary, with no in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of skill format, authoring and discovery, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as described.
